name: splendor
description: Offline-first Splendor (family edition) with local play and a built-in LAN server

scripts.test: npm run test -w @splendor/engine && npm run test -w @splendor/client && npm run test -w @splendor/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @splendor/engine && npm run typecheck -w @splendor/client && npm run typecheck -w @splendor/server
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run data:verify && npm run build
scripts.build: npm run build -w @splendor/engine && npm run build -w @splendor/client
scripts.lan: npm run build && npm run start -w @splendor/server
scripts.lan:quick: npm run build -w @splendor/engine && npm run start -w @splendor/server
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/dev/play-test.mjs && node scripts/dev/mobile-test.mjs && node scripts/dev/shots-regression.mjs
